production_environment.note: Floorp has no separate FxA/Sync staging environment. The product owner explicitly approved production-service validation and mobile Notes Sync enablement before public iOS distribution. No endpoint GUID is invented: authority is the existing release configuration and pinned endpoint policy.
production_environment.application_record_authority: Floorp-Projects/application-services components/floorp-prefs-sync README.md and engine.rs at b6d29804c391a573ecc0db6c1c4491b3e07a6693; matches Desktop getPrefsGUIDForTest coverage in Floorp-Runtime ca3d0003976321fd67061d463ab56958b0f38cd9
production_environment.oauth_authority: existing Floorp iOS FxA release path; Notes requests no new OAuth scopes and receives no token
production_environment.account_isolation: two dedicated production QA accounts with no unrelated Sync data

test_account_policy.secrets_source: CI secret environment variables only; never arguments, logs, or artifacts
test_account_policy.cleanup: disconnect both QA accounts, reset their Notes Sync state, and erase simulator keychains even on failure; account deletion is recorded when authority permits it
test_account_policy.proxy_trace: host/URL metadata only; no content, token, or key bytes

role_registry.authority: approved the production service contract, mobile enablement scope, and rollback requirement on 2026-08-09
approves engine, transport, and secret-handling evidence
approves account isolation and proxy-trace privacy evidence
approved production-capable implementation before public iOS distribution; final G6 signature remains required

policies.fxa: FxA/Application Services sync15 path only; never direct Sync REST or raw tokens in app code
policies.e2ee: encrypted by the sync15 engine; content never leaves the encrypted record in plaintext
policies.retention: production QA accounts contain no unrelated Sync data; traces omit bodies/credentials and are retained 7 days; account cleanup is mandatory after the matrix
policies.reset: reset flows go through the engine authority; never destructive local deletion without explicit user action
policies.rollout: production service and mobile enablement explicitly authorized on 2026-08-09; QA-account validation, runtime kill switch, G1-G6, and rollback evidence remain mandatory before default-on release
policies.migration: fixture-driven migration; unknown payload fields preserved byte-for-byte
